difficulty_reason: The authors transport the expander-XOR restriction into monotone slice circuits by converting selector subcircuits, pushing negations into prepared slice selectors and pairing free structure variables with their complements. This preserves local substitution while yielding independent SoS degree and size hardness in the monotone model.
